population: Fixed VisA validation120: 12 categories x2 labels x5 images; one training seed; final update192

definitions.macro_f1: Mean of normal-class and anomaly-class F1, not a mean across categories
definitions.box_recall: Union-rectangle recall at IoU>=0.5 over all60 anomalous sources, including detection/format failures
definitions.prompt_consistency: Both prompts valid and predict the same boolean / all120 paired sources; any invalid output is a separate retained status
definitions.error_bars: Observed source-bootstrap metric intervals from evaluation metrics, when present; pointwise intervals are not paired-difference evidence
definitions.ce: Raw logged assistant-only cross-entropy. Target tasks/token budgets differ; CE is not directly comparable across tasks
definitions.memory: Observed maximum allocated CUDA memory in training completion event, in GiB; not reserved VRAM or device-wide usage
